name: Emby Watch-State Migration
description: Migrate watched flags and resume positions per user from an Emby server into Matinee.
author: Anna Reber

config.label: Emby server URL
config.description: For example http://emby.local:8096 or https://192.168.1.10:8096. No trailing slash.

config.label: Accept self-signed certificates
config.description: Skips certificate verification for the Emby server. Only for a server whose certificate is not signed by a CA this server trusts.

config.label: Emby API key
config.description: Create one under Emby Dashboard, Advanced, API Keys.

config.label: User matching
config.description: Drag a Matinee user onto an Emby user to migrate that pair. Unassigned users are skipped.

config.label: Mirror the source exactly (may unwatch items in Matinee)
config.description: Off = only set watched flags and resume positions, never unwatch.
